title: Angelica sinensis tincture for medicinal use
intro: Angelica sinensis tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the dried roots of the Angelica sinensis plant, commonly known as dong quai. It is widely used in traditional Chinese medicine and herbalism for its purported ability to support hormonal balance and promote circulation. This preparation is often taken to alleviate symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and mood swings, and is also used to address menstrual irregularities. It is typically diluted in water or alcohol before consumption to reduce its potency and potential side effects. Due to its potential interactions with medications, it should be used under the guidance of a qualified herbalist or healthcare provider.
